objective: Evaluate, ex post and without a guarantee claim, whether each predeclared complete rolling five-year cohort has annualised cost-aware time-weighted total return of at least 5%.

public_price_diagnostic.reason: The public unadjusted-price four-ETF vector has 207 of 633 complete rolling five-year price windows below 5% and has no total-return, cost, tax, market-status or execution coverage.

official_index_discovery.reason: Each of six predeclared official CSI index-value paths has at least one rolling five-year miss; the closest 30/70 published reference has 32 misses of 999 and a 4.43% minimum. Index values remain weaker than investor-level net TWRR.

licensed_data_configuration.finding: No source entitlement, accountable data-owner attestation or configured Tushare, JQData or Wind research-data path is available in this case.

replay_engine.finding: The existing portfolio engine applies discrete 100-share lots. It is not a unitized, scale-neutral performance engine.

cross_asset_adapter_coverage.finding: The current Tushare adapter covers listed-stock daily bars, limits, suspensions, dividends and listing status, but not the required ETF fund price/distribution, REIT event, bond coupon/redemption and non-standard corporate-action domains.

formal_data_hierarchy.requirement: One contractually authorised point-in-time EOD source with a named data owner and immutable raw-response archive.
required_domains: dated availability of every selection input

formal_data_hierarchy.requirement: Reconcile sampled return events and product mechanics to SSE/SZSE/CNINFO, fund or REIT manager, ChinaClear, venue and broker documents.
formal_data_hierarchy.boundary: Primary documents validate events and mechanics but do not alone form a scalable point-in-time cross-asset history.

formal_data_hierarchy.requirement: Frozen public observations may support discovery and sensitivity checks only.
formal_data_hierarchy.boundary: They cannot upgrade a replay to formal evidence.

required_build_sequence: Hash-freeze the OU-TR5 rulebook, including universe, selection/replacement logic, availability and publication-lag rules, target exposure/rebalance/drift, no-fill treatment, costs/taxes, event accounting and B0/B1 definitions before seeing an outcome.
Probe and attest the chosen data source field-by-field; archive every raw response with source, as_of, available_at, owner and content hash.
Implement a unitized scale-neutral replay layer separate from any discrete-lot/minimum-fee feasibility simulator.

Add structure-specific event adapters and reject any unhandled rights, merger, spin-off, conversion, non-cash delisting, fund/REIT distribution or bond redemption event rather than synthesize a return.
Run an adversarial reconciliation set spanning a cash distribution, share distribution, non-standard action, halt, limit lock, delisting and fund/REIT event before a broad replay.
Use a predeclared training/holdout and walk-forward design; disclose every complete overlapping and non-overlapping five-year result, including failures.
Perform independent B0/B1 reconciliation and candidate-specific concentration, liquidity, cost and execution review before any T3/T4 consideration.

acceptance_gates.pass_condition: A versioned, hashed rulebook exists before any performance output.
acceptance_gates.current_status: partially specified; no deterministic T2 rule

acceptance_gates.pass_condition: All required domains are contractually authorised, archived and assigned to an accountable data owner.
Every decision date has a member list, availability timestamp, historical market state and exclusion record.
One return convention is used: raw price plus complete event ledger, or a verified total-return series; distributions are never double counted.
A unitized daily value series records proportional costs and residual/no-fill states without a fixed-lot assumption.
All predeclared complete five-year out-of-sample windows are reported; every miss remains in the record.
Separate current-session access, suitability, tax, lot, fee, liquidity and capacity evidence is complete for named candidates.

scope_control.strategy_catalog_review: A-share factor tilt and earnings-event repricing are draft, research-only target constructors without point-in-time total-return evidence. Domestic-futures CTA is a separate conditional scope whose public continuous series is intentionally blocked from P&L replay. None may be substituted for the present evidence gap.
scope_control.scope_expansion: Adding futures, options, offshore or institutional long-short strategies would require a separate mandate and legal/access/data review.

conclusion: No usable strategy allocation, historical 5% result, expected return, probability or execution conclusion is available. Continue only through the gated licensed-data and scale-neutral-replay path; retain q=0.
